mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_document_chunk_embedding ( tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, chunk_id, embedding_model, index_version, embedding, indexed_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) SELECT tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, document_id, id, #{embeddingModel}, #{indexVersion}, CAST(#{embedding} AS vector), #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy} FROM kb_document_chunk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{chunkId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, chunk_id, index_version) DO UPDATE SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, indexed_at = EXCLUDED.indexed_at, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, version = kb_document_chunk_embedding.version + 1 WHERE kb_document_chunk_embedding.embedding_model = EXCLUDED.embedding_model
mapper.delete: WITH obsolete AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT candidate.ctid FROM kb_document_chunk_embedding candidate WHERE candidate.updated_at <= #{updatedBefore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_knowledge_index_active active WHERE active.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND active.knowledge_base_id = candidate.knowledge_base_id AND active.embedding_model = candidate.embedding_model AND active.active_index_version = candidate.index_version ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_knowledge_index_rebuild rebuild WHERE rebuild.tenant_id = candidate.tenant_id AND rebuild.knowledge_base_id = candidate.knowledge_base_id AND rebuild.target_embedding_model = candidate.embedding_model AND rebuild.index_version = candidate.index_version AND rebuild.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY candidate.updated_at, candidate.tenant_id, candidate.knowledge_base_id, candidate.chunk_id, candidate.index_version FOR UPDATE OF candidate SKIP LOCKED LIMIT #{batchSize} ) DELETE FROM kb_document_chunk_embedding candidate USING obsolete WHERE candidate.ctid = obsolete.ctid
mapper.select: WITH eligible_chunks AS ( SELECT chunk.id FROM kb_document_chunk chunk JOIN kb_document document ON document.tenant_id = chunk.tenant_id AND document.knowledge_base_id = chunk.knowledge_base_id AND document.id = chunk.document_id AND document.deleted_at IS NULL AND document.parse_status IN ('CHUNKED', 'VECTORIZING', 'AVAILABLE') WHERE chunk.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND chunk.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND chunk.status = 'ACTIVE' AND chunk.deleted_at IS NULL ), activation_candidate AS ( SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eligible_chunks) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM eligible_chunks eligible WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_chunk_embedding candidate WHERE candidate.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND candidate.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND candidate.chunk_id = eligible.id AND candidate.embedding_model = #{embeddingModel} AND candidate.index_version = #{indexVersion} ) ) ), activated AS ( INSERT INTO kb_knowledge_index_active ( tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, embedding_model, active_index_version, activated_at, activated_by, updated_at, updated_by ) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{embeddingModel}, #{indexVersion}, #{activatedAt}, #{activatedBy}, #{activatedAt}, #{activatedBy} FROM activation_candidate ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, knowledge_base_id) DO UPDATE SET embedding_model = EXCLUDED.embedding_model, active_index_version = EXCLUDED.active_index_version, activated_at = EXCLUDED.activated_at, activated_by = EXCLUDED.activated_by, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, version = kb_knowledge_index_active.version + 1 RETURNING tenant_id, knowledge_base_id, active_index_version ), available_documents AS ( UPDATE kb_document document SET parse_status = 'AVAILABLE', updated_at = #{activatedAt}, updated_by = #{activatedBy}, version = version + 1 WHERE document.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND document.knowledge_base_id = #{knowledgeBaseId} AND document.parse_status = 'VECTORIZING' AND document.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activated) RETURNING document.id ) SELECT active_index_version FROM activated
